signatureAbility.signatureActivationDescription: Make consecutive passes for 5+ yards in air
signatureAbility.signatureDescription: The best quarterbacks learn to take calculated risks. When they enter the zone, they can't be intercepted (by AI defenders) and have increased throw speed.
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all lob or touch passes (except high/low and cross-body throws).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws inside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability are immune to throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while their feet are set in the pocket
Passers with this ability improve the catching prowess of all tight ends who are open on pass plays.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
Zone Hawk defenders lock down a part of the field. When they enter the zone, this ability increases the rate of interceptions while in zone coverage.
Defenders with this ability have higher chance to catch uncontested interceptions, and they have unlimited stamina on the return (until using a special move or breaking a tackle).
Defenders with this ability force more catch tackle knockouts in man-to-man versus medium routes, 10-20 yards from the LoS.
Defenders with this ability do not allow broken tackles and cause more fumbles when cut-sticking ballcarriers.
When lined up as a receiver; players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments; and react more promptly to playmaker inputs.
Players with this ability will distract defenders for longer with their runoffs
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting spin pass rush moves
Defenders with this ability are refunded a pass rush point when they successfully shed blocks
Defenders with this ability will ignore one bar of blocker resistance when attempting speed pass rush moves
